hook: A shipwrecked swordsman hunting the sea monster that sank him, and any rival worth the fight.
pick: You want the most content and the most optional battles on one route.
watch: Bertrand's Paralogue is 9/17 only. Several Paralogue windows stack in Ch 9–11.
why: Most Paralogues (8), so the most Karma Shards early. Explores the desert for later paths.

team.summary: Fifteen units. Two Bishops (Yang Jie, Dante) heal, two Ovates (Fabio, Olympia) deal magic damage, two Dreadnoughts (Esmeralda with thrown spears, Goliath on chokepoints) hold lines, and two Warriors (Mikaela, Simon) hit with Practiced Art. Kiroc, Jester and Ursula cover bows. Io, Ursula and Gaitz are mounted. Catania is the only flier, as a Wing Soldier. Ranger has an owner; Guardian and Blacksmith don't. Eight units reach Advanced before Part II: Yang Jie (Bishop), Fabio (Ovate), Dietrich (Shido), Esmeralda (Dreadnought), Mikaela (Warrior), Kiroc (Sniper), Olympia (Ovate) and Goliath (Dreadnought, Ch 12 or Part II Ch 1); Dante, Simon and Jester take theirs in Part II Ch 1 to 2.
gaps: Both armored tanks are weak to magic: keep a Bishop adjacent, let Fabio and Olympia (high Res) face enemy mages, and have Kiroc snipe them first.
Guardian has no user. Nobody here pairs Spear with useful White Magic; unlock it for Theodora and later paths.

One flier where Part II wants 2 to 3. Catania joins late (Renown 8, usually Ch 10) and needs Flying D before Wing Soldier; Part II Ch 2 wants fliers to catch the southeast Ranger before Turn 4. A second flier would be Mikaela as Wing Soldier, but she'd need Spear and Flying from zero and drops her Axe and Bow.
Only 2 Physic users. Yang Jie and Olympia learn Physic at White Magic B. Dante can't learn it, so she heals adjacent only.
Jester's Ranger waits on Oko (Renown 10, late Ch 11 or Ch 12). He stays Rogue until then.
Late joiners: Dante, Catania and Gaitz join at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class (Ch 10+). Simon, Dante and Jester take Advanced in Part II Ch 1 to 2; Goliath may slip there too.
Mini Bow count is unknown on this route. One lies south of Dagsion; Kiroc gets it first.
Blacksmith has no user. Unlock it for later paths.
fixes: Healers: Yang Jie (Bishop), Dante (Bishop), Olympia (Ovate, backup White Magic)
Physic: Yang Jie and Olympia (White Magic B). Dante can't learn it
Magic: Fabio (Ovate), Olympia (Ovate), Dante (Black Magic from Bishop)
Tanks: Esmeralda (Dreadnought), Goliath (Dreadnought), Simon (Warrior, Close Call)
Physical damage: Dietrich (Shido), Mikaela (Warrior), Simon (Warrior), Catania (Wing Soldier)
Mounted: Io (Light Cavalry), Ursula (Charioteer), Gaitz (Armored Ornius Rider)

9.title: The Legend of the White Egg

roster.name: Gaitz
roster.why: Bertrand's team out of the tournament (~Ch 12)

deployment.summary: The default five for every map are Dietrich, Yang Jie, Fabio, Esmeralda and Kiroc, plus one flex slot: Mikaela by default, Goliath on chokepoints, Jester or Io on thief and flier maps. Io holds the sixth slot in Ch 5, Olympia deploys every map from Ch 8, and Catania and Goliath join the big maps from Ch 10. Bertrand's physical army (Ch 11) benches Fabio for the armors; Mars (Ch 12) deploys 10 with Ursula and Dante in and Mikaela out. Jester, Simon, Ursula and Gaitz train ranks in skirmishes and the Arena and catch up through Part II Army Training.

phases.note: Ch 1 to 3 field Dietrich, Fabio and Esmeralda; Fabio heals until Yang Jie joins in Ch 4. Cai and Anatolia (lose if they fall), Sha Lan and Tialla are Ch 4 allies. Ch 5 Shadowy Cave: Io and Yang Jie take the far left lever, Dietrich and Fabio go right.

Most maps take 5 to 6: the default five plus a flex. Flex: Mikaela by default, Goliath on chokepoint or armor maps, Jester when fliers or a fast thief show up, Olympia for a second healer. Olympia deploys every map from Ch 8 when a seventh slot shows. Talimun's Paralogue: Io or Jester in the flex for the thief. Theodora's Paralogue: Io and Jester in for Kiroc and Fabio.

Ch 10 Anatolia: the default five, Mikaela, and Io or Ursula for the switches; more slots go to Olympia, Goliath, Catania, Dante. Anna's Paralogue takes only 3 (Dietrich, Yang Jie, Catania; Fabio if Catania isn't in). Ch 11 Bertrand: Fabio sits, eight deploy. Ch 12 Mars: ten deploy, Ursula and Dante in, Mikaela out.

Dietrich.why: Lord and your strongest Part I unit; always deploys and solos Mars in Ch 12.
Dietrich.partII: Shido from Part I; leads every map. No exams until Part III.

Fabio.why: Joins Ch 1: Black Magic and the armor answer; heals until Yang Jie arrives.
Fabio.partII: Ovate from Part I: main magic damage and a magic tank.

Esmeralda.why: Joins Ch 2: armored spear tank with thrown spears; holds the line all route.
Esmeralda.partII: Dreadnought from Part I: physical tank. Keep a Bishop beside her against mages.

Mikaela.why: Joins Ch 4 and fills the melee axe slot from the start; Practiced Art fixes her Hit once she's a Warrior.
Mikaela.partII: Warrior from Part I (Ch 11 at Lv 35).

Yang Jie.why: Joins Ch 4 and is the only real healer until Olympia; Physic at White Magic B.
Yang Jie.partII: Bishop from Part I: one of two Physic healers.

Kiroc.why: Joins Ch 6: in the default five for every map, the bow for fliers and enemy mages (carry the Mini Bow).
Kiroc.partII: Sniper from Part I: long range for shields and the anti-flier bow.

Io.why: Holds the sixth slot in Ch 5 (Shadowy Cave levers). From Ch 6 he sits except on thief and switch maps (Talimun's, Theodora's Paralogue, Ch 10 switches).
Io.partII: Light Cavalry from Part I; stays Specialty.

Olympia.why: Joins Ch 8: second healer, second mage and second Physic user; deploys every map from Ch 8 to reach Ovate.
Olympia.partII: Ovate from Part I if she reached Lv 35 (7th on the Advanced list), else a Part II Ch 1 to 2 License.

Catania.why: Joins at Renown 8 (usually Ch 10) and is the only flier; she needs battles to reach Wing Soldier before Part II.
Catania.partII: Stay Wing Soldier through Army Training and send her at the Ch 2 southeast Ranger before Turn 4.

Goliath.why: Joins Ch 8 to 9 (Giant's Meat): flex on chokepoint maps, then the second armored wall for Bertrand (Ch 11) and Mars (Ch 12).
Goliath.partII: Dreadnought in Ch 12 if he reaches Lv 35 (8th on the Advanced list), else Part II Ch 1 (Ch 2 if still under Lv 35).

Jester.why: Joins Ch 8 behind Kiroc: flex on flier and thief maps (Talimun's, Theodora's Paralogue), and trains his bow in skirmishes.
Jester.partII: Rogue from Part I; Ranger on a Part II Ch 1 Advanced License (Oko beaten, Bow B, Sword B; Ch 2 if under Lv 35).

Simon.why: Joins late Ch 8 (Renown 7) into the role Mikaela holds; fights skirmishes with gauntlets for Gauntlet B.
Simon.partII: Brigand from Part I, held through Army Training for Str; Warrior on a Part II Ch 1 to 2 License at Lv 35 and Gauntlet B.

Dante.why: Joins at Renown 8 (Ch 10, 8,000G) already a Priest, when Yang Jie and Olympia heal; she can't learn Physic. Deploys for Mars (Ch 12).
Dante.partII: Priest from Ch 10; Bishop on a Part II Ch 2 License at the Lv 35 floor.

Ursula.why: Joins after Talimun's Paralogue (9/18 to 9/19) at about Lv 15; deploys on the Mars right side (bows) in Ch 12.
Ursula.partII: Charioteer from Part I; stays Specialty. Long range for shields, storage access.

Gaitz.why: Joins in Ch 12, the last free time, already an Armored Ornius Rider: no slot and no time to level.
Gaitz.partII: Armored Ornius Rider; stays Specialty. Physical tank, Def from Army Training.

part2.note: Part II deploys up to 15 and the army is exactly 15, so everyone fights from Ch 1. Set classes before each Army Training (stats come from the current class): Simon Brigand, Dante Priest, Olympia Shaman if she isn't Ovate, Catania Wing Soldier, Gaitz Armored Ornius Rider. Advanced Licenses go to Jester (Ranger), Simon (Warrior) and Dante (Bishop), plus Olympia or Goliath if they missed Lv 35; Ch 1's floor is Lv 34, so anyone under Lv 35 takes it in Ch 2. Catania, Io, Ursula and Gaitz stay Specialty.

roles.why: Shido is the lord class for the Ch 12 solo duel with Mars; deploys every map and reaches Lv 35 first.
S tier Bishop: doubled heals, Magic Heal +10, Physic at White Magic B. Only healer from Ch 4 until Olympia.
High A Ovate: Mag +20, doubled Black Magic. Heals until Yang Jie joins in Ch 4; faces enemy mages (high Res).
Dreadnought Def +30 with thrown spears (Throwing Arm+). Very low Res: keep a Bishop beside her against mages.
Warrior: Practiced Art (Hit +10 on arts) fixes axe accuracy. In the army from Ch 4.
In the default five from Ch 6. Sniper: Bow Hit +10, Marksmanship; carries a Mini Bow, since a Sniper can't counter at range 1.
Mounted and fast: Shadowy Cave's far lever (Ch 5), Talimun's thief, Theodora's Paralogue switches, Ch 10 switches. Sits on other maps.
Second Physic user and second Ovate; Competitive Zeal adds Crit +10 to every spell. Deploys every map from Ch 8.
Only flier: Dragoon isn't unlocked on this path. Bertrand's trap switch (Ch 11) and the Part II Ch 2 Ranger chase.
Second Dreadnought for Bertrand's physical army (Ch 11) and the Mars right flank.

synergies.title: Confuse, then Tyranny
synergies.how: Fabio wears the Electron Agitator from Anatolia's Paralogue (Ch 11): its confusion is a status, and Kiroc's Tyranny is always on against foes with a status. Fabio casts first, Kiroc shoots the same target.
synergies.payoff: Kiroc gets Atk +3, Crit +10 on every foe Fabio confused

synergies.title: Armor wall, Bishop behind
synergies.how: Esmeralda and Goliath hold the chokepoints as Dreadnoughts; Yang Jie (or Olympia) stands one tile behind and Physics them from range. Dreadnoughts have very low Res, so a healer stays adjacent on mage maps.
synergies.payoff: Dreadnought Def +30 holds Bertrand's physical army; Physic heals without stepping off the line

synergies.title: Mage side
synergies.how: Mages delete the armors, so the high-Res units take the mage side: Fabio and Olympia (Ovates) and Catania. Kiroc snipes enemy mages first. Pure Water on Fabio for Anatolia's Ch 10 match.
synergies.payoff: Ovates take magic on Res and counter with doubled Black Magic (Mag +20); the Dreadnoughts' Def +30 stays on physical foes

synergies.title: Swarm, then double
synergies.how: Dante reads Archive Z on join (Ch 10) and opens with Swarm Z on the target; Mikaela, Simon and the armors then attack it.
synergies.payoff: Swarm Z: Spd -3 on the foe, so Mikaela, Simon and the Dreadnoughts double it

synergies.title: Dread arts for Jester
synergies.how: From Ch 7, Teach Secrets copies Dietrich's Hidden arts (won from Dread Warriors) to allies for Magic Echo Stones. Jester is the first target: Rogue and Ranger keep swords. The learner needs the art's weapon type.
synergies.payoff: Hidden Twinblade on Jester: Ddg +20 (crit avoid) through the enemy phase, not Avo

synergies.title: Switch runners
synergies.how: Mounted units reach switches first (Ch 10 Anatolia, Theodora's Paralogue), Io or Jester catch Talimun's thief, and Catania flies up to Bertrand in Ch 11 to switch off the trap squares.
synergies.payoff: Switches fall a turn sooner, and Bertrand's traps (about 8 HP a step) stop draining the army

synergies.title: Two Physic users
synergies.how: Both learn Physic at White Magic B: Yang Jie as Bishop, Olympia as backup White Magic. Bring both to Bertrand's map and the Mars split, one per side.
synergies.payoff: Ranged heals on both flanks of the Mars map; Dante adjacent-only heals cover the third

mechanics.what: 1-on-1 duels: Dietrich alone against a Dread Warrior. Each opens at a Renown level, from Borges (Renown 2) to Oko (Renown 10), and pays gold, 150 Renown and a Hidden Combat Art. All end 11/27. Il-Lara unlocks Guardian, Oko unlocks Ranger.
mechanics.impact: Your main Renown source, since this path has no Send Supplies. Clear each one the chapter it opens: leaving them for 11/27 makes the Renown 8 gate (Dante, Advanced exams) and the Renown 10 gate (Gaitz, Oko) slip.

mechanics.what: Opens in Ch 7. Copies Dietrich's Hidden arts, and only those, to other units for Magic Echo Stones. The learner needs the art's weapon type (Hidden Windpierce wants a 1-2 range spear).
mechanics.impact: Jester first: Rogue and Ranger keep swords. Hidden Twinblade is Ddg +20, crit insurance, not Avo; his dodging comes from Avo (Phantom Ring, Haze Slice, Kalla's Blessing).

mechanics.what: Answerer's Cry (Dietrich only, from Ch 4) summons skirmishes; foes with a bag icon drop Magic Echo Shards. Boosting 10 different Combat Arts at Smyrnos's Temple unlocks the Blacksmith class for later paths: about 400 shards?, plus Renown 8; Smyrnos Blessing Lv 1 is a condition?
mechanics.impact: Farm skirmishes with spare Turns all route and finish the 10 boosts by Ch 11. Spend every shard before Part II: each Part II chapter sets shards to 100?. Nobody here takes Blacksmith.

mechanics.what: Unlocks carry over only once all 12 chapters are done. This path gives Guardian (Il-Lara), Ranger (Oko) and Blacksmith; it pays about 5,000 Karma Shards (8 Paralogues, the most of any lord), and the desert map is shared across the save (Cai can't enter it in Part I).
mechanics.impact: Dragoon isn't unlocked yet, so Catania's Wing Soldier is the only flier you can make. Guardian has no user here: Esmeralda plays armored. Beat Oko even though Jester only takes Ranger in Part II. First Boon: Increase EXP +10% at 500 shards.

mechanics.what: An Archive is used up when read: the spell stays on that unit for good and takes no slot. One copy of each per route. Fabio learns Miasma, Mire, Death, Luna and Dark Spikes by rank, so only Banshee and Swarm are new to him.
mechanics.impact: Fabio reads θ (Banshee Θ: immobilize at range 1-3; Iapetus Cavern, Ch 11). Dante reads Z (Swarm Z: Spd -3; Southern Passage, Ch 9) and T (Dark Spikes Τ: 60 Mt vs cavalry, 2 uses; Vandahl). Olympia reads Γ (Death Γ: Mt 15, Crit 20; Vandahl from about Ch 10). Skip B (Mire) and L (Luna).

mechanics.what: Two recruited units bathe together: HP, magic uses and Motivation restored, Support between them, and one random temporary Ability each from the bath's pool, lasting to the end of the chapter. Sunday Special Baths hold the "+" abilities. 500G a bath?; Renown 9 adds three baths.
mechanics.impact: Book a Sunday Special Bath the last week before each main battle: Unicorns' Bath on Catania before Bertrand, Giants' Bath (Crit, Str) or Sea-Tyrant's Bath (HP, Def) on Dietrich before Mars, Harpyrian Bath on the healers.

mechanics.what: Recruits scale to the chapter: Ch 4 to 5 joins come at base level, Ch 6 to 9 at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class, Ch 10 to 12 at about Lv 25 already Specialty. Unrecruited Jester, Dante and Goliath fight for Bertrand in Ch 11.
mechanics.impact: Six recruits need Support 3 (Jester, Olympia, Goliath, Simon, Ursula, Gaitz) and Dante Support 2: start their meals in Ch 5 and 6. Recruit Dante and Goliath before the Ch 11 battle. Part II Army Training lifts every late joiner to Lv 34 to 39.

mechanics.what: Every free time from Ch 4, no Turn cost, reset on Sunday: 3 Inn meals (Dietrich + 2 targets, 150G on Sunday instead of 300G), one gift per target, one Arena session (two units), Divine Services on each god's day, the Pale Raven, god audiences when a temple shows gold (about 50 Renown, from Renown 2). Spare Turns: Answerer's Cry skirmishes, then the Inn.
mechanics.impact: Recruit Support only counts with Dietrich, so every meal seats him; the first gift (a 27G pastry) only unlocks meals. Serve each god on its day (a free Perfect): Mon Aurora (halves physical damage), Tue Mars (physical Hit +50), Wed Smyrnos (magic Hit +50), Thu Jurah, Fri Kalla (Avoid +50), Sat Credna (fog vision). Send Dietrich plus your top Support target. Priority: Aurora, Kalla, Smyrnos, Mars, then Jurah and Credna.
